info.name: Handee API - Complete Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive automated and manual test suite for Handee ASP.NET Core REST API.

### Features:
- Chained authentication and role management (Admin, Customer, Provider)
- Dynamic ID extraction and variable synchronization
- Seeded data verification & health check
- Comprehensive positive workflow execution across profiles, categories, listings, reviews, bookings, and payments
- Extensive negative & security authorization validations (400, 401, 403, 404, 409)

item.name: 99 - Negative / Authorization Tests
item.description: Rigorous security, validation, unauthorized access, and error-handling tests (400, 401, 403, 404).

item.name: 99.01 - Register - Invalid Role [400 Bad Request]
item.description: Attempting to self-register with an unauthorized role must fail with 400 Bad Request.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {

item.name: 99.02 - Register - Missing Required Password [400 Bad Request]
item.description: Registration missing password payload must fail model validation with 400 Bad Request.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {

item.name: 99.03 - Login - Wrong Password [401 Unauthorized]
item.description: Login attempt with incorrect password must return 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 99.04 - Login - Non-existent User [401 Unauthorized]
item.description: Login attempt with unregistered email must return 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 99.05 - Protected Endpoint - Missing Token [401 Unauthorized]
item.description: Calling protected endpoint without Authorization Bearer header must return 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 99.06 - Protected Endpoint - Malformed JWT Token [401 Unauthorized]
item.description: Sending invalid/corrupted JWT signature must return 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 99.07 - Admin Endpoint - Customer Token Forbidden [403 Forbidden]
item.description: Customer attempting to access admin user management must return 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 99.08 - Provider Verification - Customer Token Forbidden [403 Forbidden]
item.description: Customer attempting to approve provider verification must return 403 Forbidden.

item.name: 99.09 - Provider Profile - Non-existent ID [404 Not Found]
item.description: Requesting a non-existent provider profile GUID must return 404 Not Found.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 404 Not Found", function () {

item.name: 99.10 - Internal Trust Signals - Missing API Key [401 Unauthorized]
item.description: Accessing internal AI trust signals without `X-Internal-Api-Key` must return 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 99.11 - Internal Trust Signals - Invalid API Key [401 Unauthorized]
item.description: Accessing internal trust signals with incorrect secret key must return 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 99.12 - Refresh Token - Invalid / Garbage Token [401 Unauthorized]
item.description: Sending invalid or unknown refresh token must return 401 Unauthorized.
